title: After the Arima Kinen: God-Tier Freedom

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer runs in the Arima Kinen. Her return to the Twinkle Series feels so fulfilling that she literally shakes from her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone has their eyes on Oguri Cap, who also runs spectacularly despite the pressure. She tells Mejiro Palmer that she turns that pressure into power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer declares that she'll get strong enough to never worry about pressure.
